description: Regulations and standards that bear on autonomous systems, filtered by keyword, jurisdiction (e.g. 'European Union', 'United States', 'California'), or control ID. Each lists the controls it maps to and how strongly (required, implied, recommended, proposed).

control.description: Keep only rules that map to this control. A control ID such as C-V1; list_controls gives every ID.

jurisdiction.description: Keep only rules from one place, matched as part of the name: 'European Union', 'United States', 'California', 'Japan'.

limit.description: How many results to return, from 1 to 50. Default 10.

query.description: Keywords that must all appear in the rule's title, summary or issuing body, such as 'crash reporting' or 'incident notification'.

name: find_rules
title: Find rules
